Vendored commit: 9db90b86e46a377609305e298dd92d71cd1d4c8a  (2023-12-02)
Vendored on:     2026-09-10

Why a copy and not a submodule
------------------------------
The two changes below have to live inside the emulator core (a hook callback in the
CPU instruction loop), which a submodule cannot carry. The core is otherwise
self-contained: only snes/ is copied, and it pulls in nothing but libc.

What was copied
---------------
  snes/{apu,cart,cpu,dma,dsp,input,ppu,snes,snes_other,spc,statehandler}.c
  snes/{apu,cart,cpu,dma,dsp,input,ppu,snes,spc,statehandler}.h
  LICENSE.txt

Not copied: main.c (SDL frontend), tracing.[ch], zip/, resources/, Makefile.

Local modifications (all marked with a "// dream:" comment)
-----------------------------------------------------------
1. cpu.h  — added the CpuHookHandler typedef, the `hook` / `hookCtx` fields on
            struct Cpu, and the cpu_checkIntPublic() declaration.
2. cpu.c  — cpu_init() clears hook/hookCtx; cpu_runOpcode() calls the hook with the
            24-bit PC before fetching an opcode and returns early if it reports the
            instruction handled; added cpu_checkIntPublic(), a public wrapper around
            the static cpu_checkInt() so a hook can end a replaced routine with the
            same interrupt latch the real last cycle performs.
3. apu.c, snes.c, cart.c, snes_other.c — five upstream -Wall -Wextra warnings
            silenced ((void) on two unused `waiting` parameters and one unused
            `cart`, two sign-compare casts). No behaviour change.

Cart type forcing is NOT a source modification: the harness bypasses
snes_loadRom()'s header scoring by calling cart_load(cart, 2 /* HiROM */, rom,
0x200000, 0 /* no SRAM */) directly and then snes_reset(snes, true).
See recomp/README.md and recomp/harness/main.c (harness_load_rom).
